fields.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
fields.author: Harper Lee
fields.description: A young girl in 1930s Alabama watches her father defend a Black man falsely accused of a crime, confronting racial injustice and moral courage head-on.

fields.author: George Orwell
fields.description: In a totalitarian future, Winston Smith works for the Party rewriting history while secretly dreaming of rebellion against Big Brother.

fields.title: The Great Gatsby
fields.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
fields.description: Jay Gatsby throws lavish parties in pursuit of the one thing money cannot buy in this dazzling portrait of the American Dream gone wrong.

fields.title: Pride and Prejudice
fields.author: Jane Austen
fields.description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates love, class, and family expectations as she comes to understand the proud Mr. Darcy in Regency England.

fields.title: The Catcher in the Rye
fields.author: J.D. Salinger
fields.description: Holden Caulfield drifts through New York after being expelled from prep school, wrestling with alienation, loss, and the phoniness of adult life.

fields.title: Of Mice and Men
fields.author: John Steinbeck
fields.description: Two migrant workers—the sharp George and the gentle giant Lennie—chase a dream of owning their own land during the Great Depression.

fields.title: The Alchemist
fields.author: Paulo Coelho
fields.description: A young Andalusian shepherd travels across the Sahara to the Egyptian pyramids, guided by omens and the idea of a Personal Legend.

fields.title: The Kite Runner
fields.author: Khaled Hosseini
fields.description: A wealthy Afghan boy's betrayal of his loyal servant's son haunts him into adulthood, drawing him back to a transformed, Taliban-ruled homeland.

fields.title: Life of Pi
fields.author: Yann Martel
fields.description: After a shipwreck, Pi Patel survives 227 days on a lifeboat in the Pacific Ocean with a 450-pound Bengal tiger named Richard Parker.

fields.title: Brave New World
fields.author: Aldous Huxley
fields.description: In a scientifically engineered utopia where happiness is compulsory, one misfit dares to question a society built on conditioning and soma.

fields.title: The Road
fields.author: Cormac McCarthy
fields.description: A father and son traverse a burned America after an unnamed apocalypse, carrying the fire of humanity through ash, danger, and despair.

fields.title: Normal People
fields.author: Sally Rooney
fields.description: Connell and Marianne grow up in the same small Irish town and find themselves drawn together again and again despite their different social worlds.

fields.title: The Remains of the Day
fields.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
fields.description: A reserved English butler takes a road trip and reflects on a lifetime of service, dignity, and the professional duty that cost him everything personal.

fields.title: East of Eden
fields.author: John Steinbeck
fields.description: Two California families across generations re-enact the Cain and Abel story in the fertile Salinas Valley, exploring freedom, sin, and redemption.

fields.title: The Handmaid's Tale
fields.author: Margaret Atwood
fields.description: In the theocratic Republic of Gilead, Offred is a Handmaid whose only value is her fertility—and who still finds ways to resist.

fields.title: Beloved
fields.author: Toni Morrison
fields.description: Former slave Sethe is haunted by a devastating choice she made to protect her children, in this Pulitzer Prize-winning exploration of trauma and memory.

fields.title: The Color Purple
fields.author: Alice Walker
fields.description: Through letters to God and her sister, Celie chronicles her life as an abused Black woman in the American South and her gradual journey to selfhood.

fields.title: A Farewell to Arms
fields.author: Ernest Hemingway
fields.description: An American ambulance driver falls in love with a British nurse against the backdrop of World War I Italy in Hemingway's spare, devastating romance.

fields.title: Middlemarch
fields.author: George Eliot
fields.description: A sweeping portrait of life in a provincial English town, following idealistic Dorothea Brooke and her neighbors as they navigate marriage, politics, and ambition.

fields.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
fields.author: Gabriel García Márquez
fields.description: Seven generations of the Buendía family build and are undone by the mythical town of Macondo in this foundational work of magical realism.

fields.title: Crime and Punishment
fields.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
fields.description: A destitute student commits what he believes is a justifiable murder and then descends into a psychological spiral of guilt, paranoia, and confession.

fields.title: Anna Karenina
fields.author: Leo Tolstoy
fields.description: Aristocrat Anna Karenina abandons her husband for the dashing Count Vronsky—and pays the full social and psychological cost of that freedom.

fields.title: And Then There Were None
fields.author: Agatha Christie
fields.description: Ten strangers are lured to a remote island and begin to die one by one, mirroring a sinister nursery rhyme.

fields.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
fields.author: Stieg Larsson
fields.description: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist and brilliant hacker Lisbeth Salander investigate a decades-old disappearance in a powerful Swedish family.

fields.title: Gone Girl
fields.author: Gillian Flynn
fields.description: On their fifth anniversary, Nick Dunne's wife Amy vanishes. The investigation reveals that both husband and wife have carefully constructed lies.

fields.title: The Da Vinci Code
fields.author: Dan Brown
fields.description: A cryptologist and a Harvard symbologist race through Europe's greatest art while decoding a secret that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

fields.title: Big Little Lies
fields.author: Liane Moriarty
fields.description: Three school mums and a seemingly trivial playground incident converge on a Trivia Night murder in this sharp, darkly comic thriller.

fields.title: In the Woods
fields.author: Tana French
fields.description: Dublin detective Rob Ryan investigates the murder of a girl at the same woods where he survived a childhood trauma he cannot fully remember.

fields.title: The Silent Patient
fields.author: Alex Michaelides
fields.description: Famous painter Alicia Berenson has not spoken a word since the night she shot her husband. Therapist Theo Faber becomes obsessed with making her talk.

fields.title: Sharp Objects
fields.author: Gillian Flynn
fields.description: Reporter Camille Preaker returns to her Missouri hometown to cover the murders of two girls and confronts her own history of self-harm and family secrets.

fields.title: Murder on the Orient Express
fields.author: Agatha Christie
fields.description: Detective Hercule Poirot is snowbound on a luxury train when a passenger is stabbed. Every single suspect has an alibi—and a motive.

fields.title: The Thursday Murder Club
fields.author: Richard Osman
fields.description: Four unlikely friends in a retirement village meet every Thursday to investigate cold cases—until a real murder lands on their doorstep.

fields.title: Still Life
fields.author: Louise Penny
fields.description: Chief Inspector Gamache investigates the death of a beloved woman during a Thanksgiving hunt in the idyllic Quebec village of Three Pines.

fields.title: The Secret History
fields.author: Donna Tartt
fields.description: Richard Papen befriends a group of elite Greek students at a Vermont college and slowly learns the dark secret at the heart of their exclusive circle.

fields.title: Verity
fields.author: Colleen Hoover
fields.description: Struggling writer Lowen Ashby discovers an unpublished autobiography in the home of bestselling author Verity Crawford—and what she reads will upend everything.

fields.title: The Woman in White
fields.author: Wilkie Collins
fields.description: A mysterious woman in white leads drawing tutor Walter Hartright into a web of identity theft and sinister scheming in Victorian England.

fields.title: Rebecca
fields.author: Daphne du Maurier
fields.description: A young bride arrives at the grand estate of Manderley and finds herself living in the shadow of her husband's first wife, the glamorous and seemingly perfect Rebecca.

fields.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
fields.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
fields.description: Sherlock Holmes investigates the legend of a supernatural hound and a series of mysterious deaths plaguing the Baskerville family on the Dartmoor moors.

fields.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
fields.author: J.K. Rowling
fields.description: An orphan boy discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, and sets off for Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

fields.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
fields.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
fields.description: Hobbit Frodo Baggins inherits the One Ring and embarks on a perilous quest across Middle-earth to destroy it before the Dark Lord reclaims his power.

fields.title: A Game of Thrones
fields.author: George R.R. Martin
fields.description: Noble families vie for control of the Iron Throne of the Seven Kingdoms while an ancient threat stirs beyond the Wall in the frozen North.

fields.title: The Name of the Wind
fields.author: Patrick Rothfuss
fields.description: Legendary wizard Kvothe recounts his extraordinary life—from orphaned street performer to notorious arcanist and king-killer—in an inn at the edge of the world.

fields.title: The Way of Kings
fields.author: Brandon Sanderson
fields.description: On the storm-wracked world of Roshar, highprince Dalinar Kholin questions his war of vengeance while slave Kaladin discovers a forbidden power called Stormlight.

fields.title: The Hobbit
fields.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
fields.description: Reluctant homebody Bilbo Baggins is swept into an adventure with thirteen dwarves to reclaim their mountain home from the fearsome dragon Smaug.

fields.title: American Gods
fields.author: Neil Gaiman
fields.description: Ex-convict Shadow is hired by the mysterious Mr. Wednesday and drawn into an epic war between the old gods brought by immigrants and the new gods of technology.

fields.title: Good Omens
fields.author: Terry Pratchett & Neil Gaiman
fields.description: An angel and a demon who have grown fond of Earth team up to prevent the Apocalypse—mostly because neither of them wants to see it end.

fields.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
fields.author: Brandon Sanderson
fields.description: In a world where ash falls from the sky and the Lord Ruler reigns supreme, a crew of thieves plan the most daring heist in history—to steal an empire.

fields.title: The Night Circus
fields.author: Erin Morgenstern
fields.description: Two young magicians trained since childhood are pitted against each other in a mysterious competition set within a spectacular black-and-white circus.

fields.title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
fields.author: Samantha Shannon
fields.description: A queen, a dragonrider, and a spy must unite to save their world from the return of a world-consuming fire wyrm in this sweeping standalone epic.

fields.title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
fields.author: Scott Lynch
fields.description: The Gentleman Bastards are the most cunning thieves in a city of thieves—until a mysterious Grey King threatens both their lives and their latest con.

fields.title: Neverwhere
fields.author: Neil Gaiman
fields.description: When ordinary Londoner Richard helps a bleeding girl, he falls into London Below—a dark magical city beneath the streets, full of monsters and wonders.

fields.title: Outlander
fields.author: Diana Gabaldon
fields.description: In 1945 Scotland, nurse Claire Randall is transported back to 1743 and must navigate Jacobite rebellion, clan wars, and a red-haired Scottish warrior.

fields.title: The Notebook
fields.author: Nicholas Sparks
fields.description: A poor country boy and a rich city girl fall into an intense summer love in 1940s North Carolina and fight to reunite despite every obstacle.

fields.title: Me Before You
fields.author: Jojo Moyes
fields.description: Small-town girl Louisa Clark becomes carer to wealthy and sardonic Will Traynor, and what begins as a job becomes a life-altering love story.

fields.title: The Hating Game
fields.author: Sally Thorne
fields.description: Enemies Lucy and Joshua share an office, fight a silent war of pranks and glares, and are both horrified to discover that hate might actually be attraction.

fields.title: It Ends with Us
fields.author: Colleen Hoover
fields.description: When Lily meets her dream man, she also begins to see parallels between her new relationship and the domestic violence she witnessed growing up.

fields.title: The Kiss Quotient
fields.author: Helen Hoang
fields.description: Econometrician Stella Lane hires escort Michael to teach her about relationships—and their arrangement gets unexpectedly complicated by real feelings.

fields.title: Beach Read
fields.author: Emily Henry
fields.description: Two rival authors—a romance writer who's lost her faith in love and a literary novelist who doesn't believe in happy endings—make a bet that changes everything.

fields.title: People We Meet on Vacation
fields.author: Emily Henry
fields.description: Best friends Alex and Poppy have taken a summer trip together for a decade. Two years ago something went wrong—and now Poppy wants to fix it.

fields.title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
fields.author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
fields.description: Aging Hollywood icon Evelyn Hugo finally agrees to tell the story of her seven marriages—and reveals they are all connected by one great, secret love.

fields.title: The Rosie Project
fields.author: Graeme Simsion
fields.description: Genetics Professor Don Tillman creates an elaborate questionnaire to find the perfect wife and instead falls for a chaotic, rule-breaking woman named Rosie.

fields.title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
fields.author: Sarah J. Maas
fields.description: Huntress Feyre kills a wolf in the forest and is dragged into a treacherous enchanted land by a beautiful, dangerous faerie—and begins to fall for him.

fields.title: Bridgerton: The Duke and I
fields.author: Julia Quinn
fields.description: Daphne Bridgerton and the Duke of Hastings agree to a fake courtship to escape their respective problems—but their performance becomes dangerously real.

fields.title: November 9
fields.author: Colleen Hoover
fields.description: Aspiring actress Fallon and writer Ben meet on November 9th and agree to meet again every year on the same date—but secrets accumulate between them.

fields.title: The Diary of a Young Girl
fields.author: Anne Frank
fields.description: Anne Frank's journal, kept while hiding from the Nazis in a secret annex in Amsterdam, remains the most powerful first-hand account of the Holocaust.

fields.title: Long Walk to Freedom
fields.author: Nelson Mandela
fields.description: South Africa's first democratically elected president traces his journey from rural childhood to 27 years in prison to the presidency.

fields.title: Steve Jobs
fields.author: Walter Isaacson
fields.description: Based on more than 40 interviews, this biography reveals the brilliant, mercurial mind behind Apple, Pixar, and the products that changed our world.

fields.title: Becoming
fields.author: Michelle Obama
fields.description: The former First Lady of the United States traces her journey from the South Side of Chicago to the White House in this intimate and inspiring memoir.

fields.title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
fields.author: Maya Angelou
fields.description: Maya Angelou's classic memoir recounts her childhood in the American South through a tangle of racism, trauma, and the transcendent power of literature.

fields.title: Born a Crime
fields.author: Trevor Noah
fields.description: Comedian Trevor Noah grew up in apartheid South Africa as the child of a Black mother and a white father—his very existence was illegal.

fields.title: Educated
fields.author: Tara Westover
fields.description: Raised by survivalist parents with no formal schooling, Tara Westover educates herself enough to reach Cambridge University and transforms her own life.

fields.title: When Breath Becomes Air
fields.author: Paul Kalanithi
fields.description: A neurosurgeon diagnosed with terminal lung cancer reflects on the questions that drew him to medicine and what makes a life worth living.

fields.title: Open
fields.author: Andre Agassi
fields.description: One of the most candid sports memoirs ever written, tennis legend Andre Agassi reveals that he hated the game that made him famous.

fields.title: Just Kids
fields.author: Patti Smith
fields.description: Rock icon Patti Smith's memoir of her youth in New York City and her deep friendship and romance with photographer Robert Mapplethorpe.

fields.title: The Story of My Life
fields.author: Helen Keller
fields.description: Helen Keller recounts her first 22 years—deaf and blind from infancy—and the transformative relationship with teacher Anne Sullivan that unlocked her world.

fields.title: Leonardo da Vinci
fields.author: Walter Isaacson
fields.description: A biography of history's most creative genius, drawing on thousands of pages from Leonardo's notebooks to explore how he fused art and science.

fields.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
fields.author: Yuval Noah Harari
fields.description: An audacious retelling of our species' history from the Stone Age to the present—exploring how biology, culture, and technology shaped humanity today.

fields.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
fields.author: Jared Diamond
fields.description: Pulitzer Prize winner that argues geography and environment, not race, determined why some civilizations came to dominate others.

fields.title: The Silk Roads
fields.author: Peter Frankopan
fields.description: A revisionist world history that places the Middle East and Central Asia at the centre of civilisation, trade, and global power.

fields.title: A Short History of Nearly Everything
fields.author: Bill Bryson
fields.description: Bryson's irresistible tour of science and the universe—from the Big Bang to the rise of civilisation—told through the remarkable people who discovered it.

fields.author: David McCullough
fields.description: The story of the year America was born—the breathtaking military struggle that brought Washington from near disaster to improbable victory.

fields.title: The Warmth of Other Suns
fields.author: Isabel Wilkerson
fields.description: Pulitzer Prize winner chronicles the decades-long migration of Black Americans from the South to the North and West through three extraordinary individuals.

fields.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
fields.author: David Grann
fields.description: The systematic murder of the wealthy Osage Nation members in 1920s Oklahoma—and the founding of the FBI investigation that followed.

fields.title: The Devil in the White City
fields.author: Erik Larson
fields.description: The building of Chicago's 1893 World's Fair runs parallel with the story of serial killer H.H. Holmes, who hunted victims inside a lethal hotel he built nearby.

fields.title: Alexander Hamilton
fields.author: Ron Chernow
fields.description: The landmark biography of America's most enigmatic Founding Father—the inspiration for the Broadway phenomenon—that restores Hamilton to his rightful place in history.

fields.title: Empire of the Summer Moon
fields.author: S.C. Gwynne
fields.description: The dramatic and violent history of the rise and fall of the Comanche nation—the most powerful tribe in American history.

fields.title: The Rise and Fall of the Third Reich
fields.author: William L. Shirer
fields.description: The definitive history of Nazi Germany by the journalist who witnessed it firsthand, from Hitler's childhood to the ruins of Berlin in 1945.

fields.title: SPQR: A History of Ancient Rome
fields.author: Mary Beard
fields.description: Classicist Mary Beard explores 1,000 years of Roman history, asking why Rome became so powerful and what its influence means for us today.

fields.title: The Guns of August
fields.author: Barbara Tuchman
fields.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning account of the opening weeks of World War I—how miscommunication, pride, and rigid war plans led Europe into catastrophe.

fields.title: A Brief History of Time
fields.author: Stephen Hawking
fields.description: Stephen Hawking explains the origin and fate of the universe—black holes, the big bang, and the nature of time—in accessible, landmark prose.

fields.title: The Selfish Gene
fields.author: Richard Dawkins
fields.description: A revolutionary view of evolution: the gene is the unit of selection, and organisms are merely its survival machines. Introduced the word 'meme'.

fields.title: Cosmos
fields.author: Carl Sagan
fields.description: The beloved companion to Sagan's television series—a poetic, expansive journey through the universe and humanity's place within it.

fields.title: The Emperor of All Maladies
fields.author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
fields.description: A Pulitzer Prize-winning biography of cancer—from ancient Egypt to the latest immunotherapy—told through the lives of doctors, scientists, and patients.

fields.title: Being Mortal
fields.author: Atul Gawande
fields.description: Surgeon Atul Gawande confronts the medical profession's failures around aging and death, arguing for medicine that prioritises wellbeing over mere survival.

fields.title: The Body: A Guide for Occupants
fields.author: Bill Bryson
fields.description: An astonishing tour of the human body—how it works, how it developed, and why it so often goes wrong—packed with wit and wonder.

fields.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
fields.author: Daniel Kahneman
fields.description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman reveals the two systems that drive how we think—fast, intuitive System 1 and slow, deliberate System 2.

fields.title: The Gene: An Intimate History
fields.author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
fields.description: A Pulitzer Prize-winning account of the gene and the history of genetic science, from Mendel's peas to CRISPR and the ethics of editing human DNA.

fields.title: Astrophysics for People in a Hurry
fields.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson
fields.description: Neil deGrasse Tyson distils the most important ideas in astrophysics into one brief, entertaining, illuminating guide.

fields.title: The Omnivore's Dilemma
fields.author: Michael Pollan
fields.description: Three meals—industrial, pastoral, and foraged—reveal how Americans lost sight of where their food comes from and what that means for our health and environment.

fields.title: Why We Sleep
fields.author: Matthew Walker
fields.description: Neuroscientist Matthew Walker reveals the extraordinary importance of sleep for every aspect of our mental and physical health and performance.

fields.title: The Sixth Extinction
fields.author: Elizabeth Kolbert
fields.description: Pulitzer Prize winner documents how human activity is driving the sixth mass extinction in Earth's history through reportage from extinction hotspots worldwide.

fields.title: The Order of Time
fields.author: Carlo Rovelli
fields.description: Physicist Carlo Rovelli unravels the meaning of time in beautiful, lyrical prose—from thermodynamics to quantum gravity to what it means to exist.

fields.title: Charlotte's Web
fields.author: E.B. White
fields.description: When Wilbur the pig learns he is to be slaughtered, his best friend Charlotte the spider hatches a brilliant plan using words woven into her web.

fields.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
fields.author: Eric Carle
fields.description: A caterpillar eats through an increasingly large amount of food before spinning a cocoon and emerging as a beautiful butterfly. A classic first book.

fields.title: Where the Wild Things Are
fields.author: Maurice Sendak
fields.description: Young Max makes mischief, is sent to his room without supper, and sails to the land of Wild Things—where he becomes their king.

fields.title: Matilda
fields.author: Roald Dahl
fields.description: Gifted five-year-old Matilda is ignored by her dreadful parents and tormented by a horrifying headmistress—until she discovers she has extraordinary powers.

fields.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
fields.author: Roald Dahl
fields.description: Poor boy Charlie Bucket finds a Golden Ticket and wins a tour of Willy Wonka's magical, mysterious chocolate factory with four other children.

fields.title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
fields.author: C.S. Lewis
fields.description: Four siblings step through a magic wardrobe into the land of Narnia, enslaved in eternal winter by the White Witch, and join Aslan's fight to set it free.

fields.title: A Wrinkle in Time
fields.author: Madeleine L'Engle
fields.description: Misfit Meg Murry travels through time and space with her brother and friend on a cosmic mission to find her missing father and battle an evil force.

fields.title: The Secret Garden
fields.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
fields.description: Orphaned Mary Lennox is sent to a gloomy English manor and discovers a locked, neglected garden—and in restoring it, transforms herself and those around her.

fields.title: James and the Giant Peach
fields.author: Roald Dahl
fields.description: James escapes his horrible aunts by climbing inside a giant magical peach and setting off across the ocean on an extraordinary adventure with insect friends.

fields.title: The Giver
fields.author: Lois Lowry
fields.description: Twelve-year-old Jonas lives in a seemingly perfect community until he is selected as the Receiver of Memory and discovers the dark truth behind its tranquility.

fields.title: Holes
fields.author: Louis Sachar
fields.description: Wrongly convicted Stanley Yelnats is sent to Camp Green Lake, where boys dig holes all day long—and where something buried long ago is waiting to be found.

fields.title: The BFG
fields.author: Roald Dahl
fields.description: Sophie is snatched from her orphanage by the Big Friendly Giant, the only nice giant in Giant Country, and together they hatch a plan to stop the others eating humans.

fields.title: Atomic Habits
fields.author: James Clear
fields.description: A proven framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones, showing how tiny changes in daily behaviour compound into remarkable results.

fields.title: How to Win Friends and Influence People
fields.author: Dale Carnegie
fields.description: The landmark self-help classic that has sold over 30 million copies, teaching the fundamental techniques of handling people and becoming genuinely likeable.

fields.title: The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up
fields.author: Marie Kondo
fields.description: The KonMari method of decluttering: keep only what sparks joy, fold your clothes correctly, and transform your home—and your mindset—forever.

fields.title: Essentialism: The Disciplined Pursuit of Less
fields.author: Greg McKeown
fields.description: Essentialism isn't about how to get more things done—it's about how to get the right things done and reclaim control of your time and energy.

fields.title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
fields.author: Stephen R. Covey
fields.description: A principle-centred approach to personal and professional effectiveness that has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide.

fields.title: Deep Work
fields.author: Cal Newport
fields.description: The ability to focus without distraction is becoming increasingly rare and increasingly valuable. Newport shows how to cultivate this skill and win in the knowledge economy.

fields.title: Getting Things Done
fields.author: David Allen
fields.description: The definitive guide to stress-free productivity: a systematic method to capture everything competing for your attention, then process and organise it.

fields.title: The Power of Habit
fields.author: Charles Duhigg
fields.description: Investigative reporter Charles Duhigg explains the science of habit formation and how understanding the habit loop can transform your life, business, and society.

fields.title: Never Split the Difference
fields.author: Chris Voss
fields.description: Former FBI lead international hostage negotiator Chris Voss shares nine counterintuitive principles that will make you more persuasive in every situation.

fields.title: Daring Greatly
fields.author: Brené Brown
fields.description: Researcher Brené Brown argues that vulnerability—the willingness to show up and be seen—is not weakness but the greatest measure of courage.

fields.title: Scam Pant
fields.author: Nicholas Sparks
fields.description: It's a scam
